name: Grave Danger
desc: A necromancer's survival arcade game: every monster you destroy rises from the ground as a skeleton on your side. Your followers swarm the nearest threat on their own, you upgrade your army in the Bone Merchant's shop between waves, and you face enormous bosses — your horde of the dead grows as the difficulty does. An original Arcade Phantasm game.
controls: WASD/arrows move; casting is automatic — hold the mouse to aim your spells and hold Space to rally the army; P pause, M mute
creator: CursedPrograms
